clauses.clause: Route readability: Luna reaches the depot, Annex and garage without > 60 s lost (tune).
clauses.note: Historical sweep-a2 counterexample, before the depot cue fix. Named Luna screenshot-only tester used fresh ordinary low-quality L1 and physical keyboard, consulting only screenshots and visible HUD. Root personally inspected all15 frames: initial sidewalk/depot55m; roadwork/fence corner47m; back parking lot24m; blue bins and wooden fence20m; repeated returns to same fence gap, depot wall and bins. Courier/corgi remain visible, HUD100/100. From frame004 at40s through014 at130.0167s the tester loops20–47m without reaching depot or advancing objective:90.0167s lost, exceeding60s. E at20m leaves objective unchanged; movement plainly works, so this is navigation failure, not rejected-input setup. Annex/garage not reached. No tuning made: a small clear fix was not established. A low-quality counterexample establishes FAIL; high-quality route has not been qualified.
